translation:
Kyon, you're late! It's your treat again
today, got it?

The sun was beating down and the scorching
asphalt burned underfoot.

I was getting roasted from all sides like I was
in a microwave.

Half-risking my life, I arrived at the café
outside the station.

As soon as Haruhi opened her mouth, she
pier- ced me with words harsher than summer sun.

You've been slacking off since we last met,
haven't you?

Since we last met? Didn't we talk just a few
days ago?

It's been a while, Kyon. Have you been doing
well?
Yeah, I've been great.
You seem to be as usual too, Asahina.

Hehehe. That's not true. I'm a little bit tanned
and stuff.

To my eyes, her skin seemed as clear and
light as ever.

A-and, I finished all my homework with
Tsuruya.
Homework… huh?

Now that I think about it, I've barely touched
mine.

Well, there's always the last week of summer
vacation to finish it off—
Are you well?
Nagato… Y-yeah.

I'm glad to hear your voice, but that wasn't
very conducive to conversation, Nagato.
Nagato, what have you been up to recently?
Nothing special.

Well, as much as you say that…
You have to have done something, right?
…Reading.
I see. It's my fault for asking.

Everyone is acting the same as usual, aren't
they?

The same goes for you Koizumi. Your easy
smile is wasted on me.
I've been looking forward to this.

Even though it's only been a few days, I feel
somewhat nostalgic.
I'm not particularly nostalgic or anything.

More importantly, don't get so close when it's
this cramped and sweltering already.

Now that we're all here, let's start the SOS
Brigade debriefing right away.
Debriefing?

You went traveling with your family, didn't
you?

Did you have any interesting experiences
while traveling?

I want a full report of everything that
happened!
We weren't exactly traveling…
Nothing particularly interesting happened.
I can't speak for the other three though.

You mean you didn't get caught up in a hot
springs murder mystery?
I didn't.

Did you witness a terrifying ritual in a
mountain village and get chased by monsters?
There's no way that would happen.

You're still having the same boring summer
vacations as always, huh.

That's why you're still only a low-ranking
brigade member!
You really need to broaden your horizons.
That's none of your business.

For the first time in a few days, the SOS
Brigade had gathered in the usual café…
It was at that moment that I got a phone call.

To think that was what gave rise to the whole
situation…
At the time, nobody could've predicted it.
Ahh, sorry—I've got a call.

Hey! Kyon! We're in the middle of an important
meeting!

That's why I said sorry…
Yeah, hello?
Hey Kyon, it's me!
Oh, Taniguchi huh… I'm hanging up, okay?
O-oi! Don't hang up!

Unfortunately, there's someone right before
my eyes, scowling at me as if they'll curse me.
Come on, just hear me out.

You and your next-door… neighbors? No,
maybe it's two doors over?

Well anyway, the computer society is near
you, right?
Uh-huh. They are.

Apparently those guys made a fuss about
encountering unnatural phenomena at school.
Unnatural phenomena?
Why the hell are you telling me?

Huh?
Don't you like that stuff?

No, I'm not the one who likes it—that would
be…

Unnatural phenomena…? Hey, Kyon, you did
just say that, right?
Oof… Damn… She heard…

Unnatural phenomena! That's a subject we
can't pass up! Tell me all the details!

I may have grown complacent because it's
been a while since the last major incident.

In any case, I would eventually come to
fiercely regret that foolish slip of the tongue.
About Haruhi
